passives.name: Incomplete Synchronization
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Depending on the class not present among enemies, grants the following effects to the caster. Striker: Increased Defense for 3 turns Mage: Increased Effectiveness for 3 turns Defender: Increased Attack for 3 turns Ranger: Increased Speed for 3 turns Healer: Increased Penetration for 3 turns All effects are Irremovable. Damage taken from Mage units decreases by [Buff_V_tower_element_52751], and damage taken from Striker units increases by [Buff_V_tower_element_52752].
